bio: Enjoy a scrumptious Afternoon Tea at the Three Church Road Restaurant set in a stunning Georgian building of St George's Place Edgbaston.  Tuck into your Afternoon Tea under sophisticated surroundings with luxurious interior creating the ideal relaxing environment to enjoy your experience.  Their menu includes a Traditional Afternoon Tea with a selection of sandwiches, traditional scones with strawberry jam along with a variety of homemade cakes, or why not treat yourself and upgrade to a Traditional Afternoon Tea with a glass of Prosecco!  Three Church Road restaurant is located right by Birmingham's botanical garden and just a 6 minute drive from Five Ways station.  On your visit your Afternoon Tea may be presented a little differently to the images displayed. The venue vary their selection of sweet treats according to seasonality and adapt their offering so that regular guests can look forward to something new each time. They also theme their Afternoon Tea from time to time, so your experience will feel a little more exclusive during events such as Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, Easter, Father’s Day, Halloween and Christmas.  A lighter Cream Tea option is available should you prefer, and  Vegan and Gluten-free dietary requirements can also be catered for. The venue politely ask that all Afternoon Tea bookings are placed in advance and that any special requests are made at the time of booking, to ensure they can provide the best possible experience on the day.
